notes: mp4: HEVC (libx265, hvc1, crf 28, yuv420p, faststart, no audio). webm: VP9 crf 36, b:v 0, no audio.
Each clip is cropped below the status bar and above the home indicator, then scaled to 590 px wide (half of 1206).
Poster is the loop's first frame; -still.jpg is a settled frame for reduced motion; stills/<name>.png is that frame at full resolution (1206 px wide, same crop).
Loops: the reel scenes run a strictly periodic timeline, so each clip is exactly one period; Spoonjoy clips are cut from settled frame to settled frame.
